select b.*, u.name assignName from business b left join user u on b.user_id = u.id
and b.id = #{businessDto.businessId}
and b.name like concat('%', #{businessDto.name}, '%')
and b.phone like concat('%', #{businessDto.phone}, '%')
and b.status = #{businessDto.status}
and u.name like concat('%', #{businessDto.assignName}, '%')
order by b.update_time desc

select b.*, tr.id tr_id, tr.business_id tr_business_id, tr.user_id tr_user_id, tr.track_status tr_track_status, tr.key_items tr_key_items, tr.next_time tr_next_time, tr.record tr_record, tr.create_time tr_create_time, u.name tr_assign_name from business b left join business_track_record tr on tr.business_id = b.id left join user u on tr.user_id = u.id where b.id = #{id} order by tr.create_time desc

select b.* from business b
and b.status = 4
and b.id = #{poolDto.businessId}
and b.name like concat('%', #{poolDto.name}, '%')
and b.phone like concat('%', #{poolDto.phone}, '%')
and b.subject = #{poolDto.subject}
order by b.update_time desc

select count(*) businessTotal, count(if(status=1,1,null)) businessWaitAllot, count(if(status=2,1,null)) businessWaitFollow, count(if(status=3,1,null)) businessFollowing, count(if(status=4,1,null)) businessFalse, count(if(status=5,1,null)) businessConvertCustomer from business
